title: Genus-3 certification oracles and stage benchmarks
objective: Provide deterministic exact genus-3 oracle fixtures, native-search differential coverage, stage-separated performance benchmarks through 10^6, and a pragmatic independent-backend audit for certified completion

oracles: Magma HyperellipticCurve point counts and EulerFactor when supported

handoff.summary: Checked in a 20-row exact Sage/PARI corpus with independent Magma coverage at small primes, an offline oracle gate, a four-stage acceptance benchmark through 10^6, a competing-backend audit, and ordinary-Cantor differential/status/worker coverage for the native Jacobian progression search. The direct addon probe is exact on Linux x64/aarch64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64. Focused receipts pass and the 10^4 raw digest is stable.
risks: The complete certification/public 10^4, 10^5, and 10^6 benchmark requires the central public-pipeline integration and can be long-running; this lane records the protocol rather than claiming an acceptance result.
Magma independently covers the small-prime corpus only; Sage/PARI is the exact source for the larger checked-in rows.
The N-API fix shortens the audited addon by one byte; integration must include group-kernel audit refresh fa1d9760 so architecture:check remains green.
The broad native suite was stopped at coordinator request after its FLINT, FFLAS, and graph sections passed; focused genus-3 native and differential gates pass.
next_steps: Integrate f3d10de3 together with group-kernel fixes 8e12889a and fa1d9760.
Run the default four-stage benchmark on an otherwise idle host and compare exact digests across Linux x64/aarch64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64.
Grow the independent exact corpus when a practical current Magma or second open backend is available at larger primes.
